summary: Bright Minds Biosciences filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its presentation at the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference and the grant of stock options to directors, officers, and consultants for 109,000 common shares at US$83.40 per share, vesting over four years. No special situation is present; this is a routine business development and compensation disclosure. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event.
